title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 10 MARCH 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 10 March 2026. A few showers are likely in Northern province and in Trincomalee and Anuradhapura districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts after 2.00 pm. Mainly dry weather will prevail elsewhere over the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Central, Sabaragamuwa, Uva and North-western provinces and in Anuradhapura, Mannar, Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
